lines.en: So, for my painting, I chose one of my very favorite Greek myths,
the centaur goddess Diophena, slaying a great stag.
Hey, Leslie, you should really come over here and look at Jerry's painting.
Oh, jeez, it does look like you.
That's what you see when you close your eyes at Nigeria, topless Leslie glued to a horse.
Okay, Leslie, I am so, so sorry.
Diophena, she is this powerful goddess, and I've been thinking a lot about powerful women,
I'm sorry, and I'm going to take it right down.
I don't know how to explain it.
Every time I look at it, I just think to myself, what can't that centaur woman do?
Besides ride an escalator and drive a car.
This is easily my favorite painting ever.
I look like a pregnant baby.
And why am I so scared?
All right, we got to take this down now.
No, this painting isn't going anywhere, Tom.
Hello, fellow lover of the arts.
